summary: Pembina Pipeline Corp filed a Form 6-K reporting the sanctioning of the Heartland Extraction Plant (HEP), a new 750 MMcf/d straddle plant, and an amended ethane supply agreement with Dow. No specific price per share, premium, or board recommendation is provided as this is an operational/capital project announcement, not a merger or acquisition. The project has an estimated cost of $570M with an in-service date in late 2029. This is a routine capital expenditure disclosure for a foreign private issuer, not a special situation.
